notes.title: Later Alligator: The Patchening
notes.notes:
Hello denizens of Alligator New York! Your humble programmer is with you today to describe the wild number of updates, changes, and fixes we've made to Later Alligator! These include:

[list]
[*] A brand new minigame featuring the coolest ally-gator on the block, Mona! Find her [spoiler]outside the antiques shop[/spoiler]!
[*] New dialog logic allows you to see different NPC dialog between playthrus; enjoy all the goofs we wrote for you!
[*] A denumont to [spoiler]the baby monitor[/spoiler] minigame; we didn't mean to leave you hanging.
[*] Sorry in advance, but we moved some puzzle pieces for boring technical reasons. That means your FAQs and guides are busted! My bad!
[*] A bunch of rebalancing and fixes and sprucing up of pretty much every minigame? I swear I touched every single one of 'em.
[/list]

notes.title: Win 7 and Linux Support Now Live!
notes.notes:
Good morning fellow alligators of Alligator Steam! This morning we shipped support for both Windows 7 and Linux, allowing even more folks to get into Alligator New York City. We're so excited to bring even more gators into our fold, and while we've done our best to ensure everything works for you on Day 1 (-ish), we understand things can happen. If you encounter issues with either of the fresh builds, please submit your reports to either the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/966320/discussions/0/1746765743928794176/]Win7[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/966320/discussions/0/1746765743928827023/]Linux[/url] threads over in the Steam community pages and we'll get you squared away as fast as possible.

Thank you again for all your support, and enjoy the game!
